name: Skailer
description:
Skailer is an HRM platform for people management. This MCP server gives AI secure access to your HR data through OAuth authorization.

Features:
• Search employees by name, position, department and other fields
• View org structure and team data
•  Manage goals and OKR 
• View timeOff and analyse them 
• Work with HR information directly from your conversation with Claude

_published_faq.name: How do I add Skailer to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Skailer to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.skailer.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Skailer MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Skailer provides these MCP tools: check_token, search_employees, search_goals, search_time_off, get_employee, get_employee_by_email, get_me, create_goal, and create_result.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Skailer?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Skailer in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Skailer requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Skailer is developed by Skailer. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
